**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve explicit empty lists in deprecated aliases**

When existing callers clear dashboard access with `dashboard.roles = []; dashboard.save()`, this guard skips the alias entirely. Since `roles` is now excluded from serialization, the PUT retains the existing `viewers` instead of clearing them, silently leaving access granted. The same problem affects clearing `owners` and Base RLS rule `roles`. Distinguish an explicitly assigned empty list from an unset alias and propagate the clearing operation to the corresponding subject field. This breaks the backward-compatible alias requirement in `AGENTS.md`.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L111-L112](https://github.com/jailtoncarlos/superset-api-plus/blob/9afe1d886d8fea55c0588dc47c0a7f24589366fc/AGENTS.md#L111-L112)

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Move the migration notes to the branch-specific document**

The new Superset 7.0 release section is added to `CHANGELOG.md`, but `AGENTS.md` explicitly requires changes on this branch to be recorded in `docs/superset-7-migration.md` until the final merge into `main`. Move this section there so the migration follows the documented release workflow and leaves the changelog available for ongoing `main` releases.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Replace existing access lists when assigning deprecated aliases**

When a dashboard already has viewers for roles A and B, assigning `dashboard.roles = [B]` and saving retains A because the resolver starts with all existing viewer IDs and only appends resolved aliases. Previously, assigning `roles` replaced the access list, so callers attempting to revoke A's access silently leave it granted. The same issue affects replacing `owners` on charts, dashboards and datasets, and replacing RLS `roles`. Preserve replacement semantics for explicitly assigned deprecated aliases rather than unconditionally merging them into the existing subject list, as required by the public API stability rule in `AGENTS.md`.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L111-L112](https://github.com/jailtoncarlos/superset-api-plus/blob/c7978352fe86ec7890bb7298b4373449258f22f3/AGENTS.md#L111-L112)
